item.title: Digitalisation News Brief — 2026-09-23
item.description:
1. [Tech News] Qualcomm launches two new smartphone chips with emphasis on AI
Qualcomm said that its new top chip can run 30B mixture-of-expert model locally.

2. [Tech News] OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, boasting lower cost and fewer mistakes
OpenAI is launching two new models, which it says are cut from the same cloth as Astra.

3. [Tech News] Nscale’s IPO will test Wall Street’s appetite for concentrated AI bets once again
The British AI data center developer depends on tech giants Microsoft and Anthropic for most of its revenue.

4. [Tech News] Andreessen Horowitz is launching an ‘academy’ with no homework and partnerships with Palantir, Google, and Meta
